verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source (Apache-2.0) 3D rendering and game engine library that runs inside the developer's own application. It is not a service that ingests user data, so an opt-out from AI-model training is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Babylon.js collecting user data for training or offering any training-related data controls that would make the axis apply.
